description: This file contains a JUnit test for the ModifySubjectsSubstitutionStrategy class, verifying its behavior when applying substitutions to ModifySubjects commands in the context of placeholder replacement.

classes.name: ModifySubjectsSubstitutionStrategyTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for Verify the behavior of ModifySubjectsSubstitutionStrategy in handling placeholder substitution.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that instances of ModifySubjectsSubstitutionStrategy are immutable.

methods.name: applyReturnsTheSameCommandInstanceWhenNoPlaceholderIsSpecified
methods.description: Test case verifying that when no placeholder is present, the command instance remains unchanged after application.

methods.name: applyReturnsTheReplacedCommandInstanceWhenPlaceholderIsSpecified
methods.description: Test case verifying that placeholders in subjects are correctly replaced with actual IDs.
